name: 色卡选择器
description: 在工作面板里浏览 Tailwind / Material / 预设色板与渐变，做和谐配色和对比度检查，生成色阶，并一键导出 CSS 变量、Tailwind 配置或 JSON。

en.name: Color Picker
en.description: Browse Tailwind, Material and preset palettes plus gradients in the work panel, check harmony and text contrast, generate a 50–950 scale, and export CSS variables, a Tailwind theme or JSON.
en.safetyNotes: No network access, no file writes, no background service. The plugin only writes to the clipboard (copying a color value) and reads the settings the host stores for it. Colors are computed locally in the panel.

zh-CN.name: 色卡选择器
zh-CN.description: 在工作面板里浏览 Tailwind / Material / 预设色板与渐变，做和谐配色和对比度检查，生成色阶，并一键导出 CSS 变量、Tailwind 配置或 JSON。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 不访问网络、不写入文件、无常驻后台服务。插件只写剪贴板（复制色值）并读取宿主为它保存的设置，全部颜色计算都在面板本地完成。
